subject.title: fix(deepinfra): use OpenAI video end point and tag DeepSeek thinking format

question: Should an explicitly configured `models.providers.deepinfra.nativeBaseUrl` continue selecting DeepInfra's native inference protocol, or may this PR reinterpret it as an OpenAI-compatible video base?
rationale: This is a shipped provider configuration and upgrade contract; source inspection can identify the break, but only maintainers can decide whether to preserve, deprecate, migrate, or intentionally remove that behavior.

options.title: Preserve Explicit Native Config
options.body: Use the new OpenAI videos endpoint by default, but keep explicitly configured `nativeBaseUrl` on the native protocol with a documented deprecation path.

options.title: Intentionally Break and Migrate
options.body: Remove the legacy semantic contract only with explicit release approval, upgrade documentation, and proof covering configured native endpoints.

options.title: Pause the Endpoint Move
options.body: Keep the current native implementation until one canonical DeepInfra video contract can cover defaults and custom endpoint configurations safely.

recommendation.title: Preserve Explicit Native Config
recommendation.body: Use the new OpenAI videos endpoint by default, but keep explicitly configured `nativeBaseUrl` on the native protocol with a documented deprecation path.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the provider integration and have the clearest historical context for whether `nativeBaseUrl` was intended as a durable custom-endpoint contract.
